title: Roasted Aubergine and Buffalo Mozzarella Pizza with Garlic and Chilli
changes_from_base: Garlic, chilli and a thin layer of blended tomato replace the full tomato sauce, deeply roasted aubergine cubes go on before baking, and torn buffalo mozzarella and basil are added only once each pizza comes out of the oven.
summary: Neapolitan-style pizzas featuring tender roasted aubergine, silky fresh buffalo mozzarella, and a bright chilli-and-garlic bite.
equipment: stand mixer with dough hook or food processor
pizza peel or flat baking sheet

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
aubergines (2 medium), cut into 2.5 cm cubes
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare dough
steps.text: Stir 1½ tsp dried yeast, 420 ml warm water and 10 ml oil in a mixer bowl and let it sit for about 5 minutes until foamy, then add 575 g flour and 1 tsp salt and mix with the dough hook for 2 to 3 minutes until smooth and slightly elastic.

steps.title: Bulk ferment
steps.text: Turn the dough into an oiled bowl, cover with cling film and chill overnight to develop flavour.

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: Cut the dough into 4 equal pieces, shape each into a tight ball, place on an oiled tray, cover loosely and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours (up to 6 hours is fine).

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Set the oven to 230 °C with shelves on the top and bottom thirds and the stone on the upper shelf; toss the 900 g aubergine cubes with 60 ml oil, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper on a rimmed tray and roast on the lower shelf for 40 to 45 minutes, turning halfway, until charred and tender.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Raise the oven to 260 °C; stretch each dough ball on a sheet of baking paper into a 30 cm round, spread 2 tbsp blended tomato leaving a 1 cm rim, scatter one quarter of the 6 sliced garlic cloves, an eighth of a teaspoon of the chilli flakes, a quarter of the 30 ml drizzling oil, and one quarter of the roasted aubergine.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Slide each pizza (paper and all) onto the hot stone and bake for 7 to 10 minutes until the base is crisp and golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Using tongs, pull each pizza onto a cooling rack, immediately tear over one quarter of the 225 g buffalo mozzarella while still hot, scatter some of the 15 g basil, add a small drizzle of extra oil and a sprinkle of flaky salt.

tips: Prepare the dough the day before to allow proper fermentation and develop rich, complex flavour
Roast the aubergine until the edges are deeply caramelised for maximum depth of flavour
Anyone pregnant should choose pasteurised buffalo mozzarella; tear it over the pizza as soon as it leaves the oven so it softens without turning rubbery.
storage: Keep leftovers chilled and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
